key_decisions.decision: Follows read teaching participle, retaining unexplained ark placement and shoulder image.
Preserves imperative sequence without silently moving consecration ahead of slaughter.
Follows read Cananiah consistently; retains sibling group and other three leaders.
Retains distribution for offering and the separate cattle clause.
Keeps general cook verb and fire-versus-vessels distinction rather than silently harmonizing terminology.
Preserves Samuel comparison and full participating assembly rather than borrowing Kings' judges wording.
Keeps difficult house-of-war phrase and Neco's divine claim as his speech.
Retains disguise and narrator's affirmation of divine speech through Neco.
Preserves two chariots and Jerusalem-before-death sequence without harmonizing Kings.
Retains female singers and documentary title without equating it to canonical Lamentations.
